paper_title: Overview of the Cosmic Axion Spin Precession Experiment (CASPEr)
coupling_convention: g_d axion-gluon (EDM) coupling in GeV^-2 (linear in g_d, not squared)
notes: Overview/proposal paper for the CASPEr program describing sensitivity projections only (no measured limits). Projections are shown graphically in Fig. 3 (CASPEr Electric, gd axion-gluon/EDM coupling in GeV^-2) and Fig. 4 (CASPEr Wind, gaNN nucleon coupling in GeV^-1), but no numerical values or tables are given in the text, so no data points could be extracted. The paper covers two distinct coupling types (AxionEDM via gd for CASPEr Electric, and axion-nucleon coupling gaNN for CASPEr Wind); AxionEDM chosen per pre-analysis hint but this is ambiguous. DM density assumed is rho_DM ~ 0.4 GeV/cm^3 per Eq. (5). Mass range discussed: ma <~ 1e-6 eV. | [VISION GATE A] is_projection=true but the vision notes say the traced curve is existing experiment 'sn1987a' — not the paper's own projected curve
